message: A purported shipping agent demands a private remittance before releasing a delivery supposedly stopped by inspectors.
An unsolicited lottery message demands a registration remittance before the winnings can be credited.
An unsolicited delivery notice demands payment on an unfamiliar website before a supposedly intercepted item can be forwarded.
An unknown contact offers to return a failed transaction only after I authorize a fresh debit to his personal account.
They told me a criminal file had been opened in my name and that paying a private intermediary would keep me out of jail.
Someone pretending to be a detective said I could end his interrogation only after making a private remittance.
A supposed merchant offers reimbursement but asks me to transfer a refundable verification amount first.
They said I was being monitored remotely and could not consult a lawyer until I paid them.
A stranger says I must disclose my secret payment passcode before he can send a compensation amount.
An impostor using a court emblem instructed me to keep our conversation secret and purchase a monetary release certificate.
A supposed delivery supervisor threatens to refer me to investigators unless I make a private payment for a seized carton.
A fake support representative insists I reveal the secret phrase I use to access my savings account.
A person claiming to work at the border depot asks for an unofficial bond to return a held shipment.
A caller claims a surveillance order is active against me and demands a refundable bond before I can speak to my relatives.
An unknown sender claims a parcel addressed to me was found with forged documents and demands a settlement outside the carrier's app.
Someone posing as a freight employee claims my goods were taken by officials and wants money through his own payment handle.
A supposed judicial official threatens an immediate criminal hearing unless a monetary clearance charge is paid to him.
The person offering to renew my bank profile insists I give him control of my device using a screen sharing application.
A supposed card service representative asked me to read out the three secret digits printed beside my signature strip.
